edbDesc: The effect wherein a circumferentially magnetized rod of ferromagnetic, magnetostrictive material generates a net axial magnetic field in response to an applied torque.
title: Garshelis Effect
pickWhy: Borderline: A torque-sensing form of inverse magnetostriction (twisting a magnetised rod makes a magnetic field); judgment call between its own card for torque sensors and merging into magnetostriction, picked merge and listed torque sensors under magnetostriction's uses.
